ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Usage Of Active Directory Diagnostic Tool (ntdsutil.exe)
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of ntdsutil.exe to perform different actions such as restoring snapshots...etc.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\ntdsutil\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "ntdsutil\.exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*snapshot.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*mount\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*ac.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ i.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ntds.*"))))
